Exercise: Cable Shoulder Press

Category:
strength

compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_extension

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- triceps

Equipment:

- cable

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC system

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- strength

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press, equipment: dumbbells
- name: Machine Shoulder Press, equipment: shoulder press machine

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Barbell Shoulder Press, equipment: barbell

Instructions:

- Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight.
- Stand directly in between the uprights. Grasp the cables and hold them at shoulder height, palms facing forward. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping your head and chest up, extend through the elbow to press the handles directly over head.
- After pausing at the top, return to the starting position and repeat.
